title: Concise sales & CS launch kit: decks, demo scripts, and budget objection play
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a compact, field-first enablement kit for the routing-optimizer launch that includes: a concise 1-slide battlecard, a 6-slide customer-facing deck, three demo scripts (quick, deep-dive, and fallback demo), an objection-handling script focused on cost vs latency, and an FAQ for Sales + CS. The kit must be consumable in a 20-minute prep window and reference technical appendix links for engineering deeper dives. Coordinate release notes highlights with Docs and Engineering, and schedule two live enablement sessions + one on-demand recording.
acceptance_criteria: One 'one-pager' battlecard PDF with clear use cases, target buyer personas, and 3 deal triggers
6-slide customer deck (editable Google Slides) with value metrics and migration path for Dedicated/Private
Three demo scripts: 5-min quickstart, 12-min technical deep-dive, 4-min fallback demo for outage scenarios
Objection playbook covering pricing, latency, privacy, and model-compatibility (3 sample responses per objection)
FAQ doc covering 25 common Qs with links to release notes and implementation guides
Recording of enablement session uploaded and linked; attendance list captured
Release notes snippet coordinated and approved by Docs & Eng and published in product release page
tasks: Draft battlecard (PM) -> design polish (DES) -> legal + pricing review
Pull metric callouts from runtime perf dashboard (Eng) and add to deck
Create demo recording environment and checklist (ENG-3261 as dependency)
Write objection playbook and sample scripts for Sales leaders to rehearse
Coordinate with Docs to add release-notes fragment and cross-link FAQ
Book two live enablement sessions and one recording slot; create registration form
